answer_2.quote: We evaluate ENIGMA, BLEU/PPL and Self-Play Evaluation (SPE) based on the correlation between estimated reward and true reward.

answer_4.quote: We invite 20 people to evaluate the 24 seller agents. Specifically, each of the 20 human customers interacts with a seller agent 5 times to generate 100 pieces of dialog, and gives each piece an evaluation score between 0 and 1.
answer_4.guideline: evaluators give scores for flight score, status score, and overall reward based on task completion and language quality.
